name: dsh-plugin-updater
description: Startup update checks for installed DSH NEXT plugins and the core, with panel appearance settings, live progress, one-click updates, a data-folder migration sheet and per-version ignore — no agent calls, no token spend.
author: TT10-24 (https://github.com/TT10-24)

description.zh: 上线时检查已安装插件与内核；DSH NEXT 区域显示当前版本和数据目录，可复制插件、工作区与对话到你选择的文件夹；三点调整面板大小与配色，全程不调用 agent、不消耗 token。
description.en: Checks installed DSH NEXT plugins and the core on every launch. Three-dot panel settings control size and color, one click updates everything, and a data-folder sheet migrates plugins, workspaces and conversations to a folder you choose — no agent calls, no token spend.
